products.name: Redgate Data Modeler
products.description: Cloud-based collaborative database modeling platform supporting PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server, and more. Provides real-time team collaboration, built-in versioning, reverse engineering, and automated SQL generation in a browser-based workspace.
products.positioning: Enterprise-grade cloud modeling for multi-database teams

products.name: SqlDBM
products.description: Cloud-native visual database modeler with native connectors to Snowflake, Databricks, and BigQuery. Supports reverse and forward engineering, column-level lineage, governance, real-time collaboration, and Git/DevOps integration.
products.positioning: Data warehouse and cloud platform modeling leader

products.name: QuickDBD
products.description: Text-first database diagram tool using a DSL shorthand notation. Creates instant visual ERD conversions from text input, supports SQL export and collaboration via URL sharing.
products.positioning: Fast text-based ERD design for rapid prototyping

products.name: ERDPlus
products.description: Free browser-based entity relationship diagram tool supporting ER diagrams, relational schemas, and star schemas. Provides SQL generation and PNG export with no sign-up required for basic use.
products.positioning: Free, simple ERD tool for students and quick sketches

products.name: pgModeler
products.description: PostgreSQL-specialist multi-platform database modeling tool with visual schema design, reverse engineering, diff/sync capabilities, and CLI for CI/CD integration. Available as open-source Community Edition and commercial Plus edition.
products.positioning: PostgreSQL-native modeling with zero cloud lock-in

products.name: DBeaver
products.description: Universal open-source database client supporting 100+ databases with comprehensive ER diagram visualization, schema editing in ERD Edit Mode, and visual query building. Available as free Community Edition and paid Enterprise tier.
products.positioning: Multi-database universal client with integrated schema visualization

notes: Coverage includes 6 enterprise/developer DB schema modeling tools across SaaS cloud (Redgate Data Modeler, SqlDBM), web freemium (QuickDBD, ERDPlus), desktop open-source (pgModeler), and desktop universal client (DBeaver). Extracted from 25 sources spanning T0 (official pages, reviews, pricing), T1 (docs, press releases, GitHub), and T2 (practitioner comparisons: dbschema.com, CTO Club, Atlassian, Holistics, Medium). Redgate acquisition of Vertabelo (closed Sept 17, 2025) captured via press release. Key finding: market stratification by use case (data warehouse/warehouse-native: SqlDBM; PostgreSQL-specialist: pgModeler; universal exploration: DBeaver; cloud-collaborative: Redgate Data Modeler; rapid prototyping: QuickDBD; free academic: ERDPlus). MetroGraph's competitive edge lies in graph-native visualization and HCI simplification vs traditional ERD tools; primary threats are DBeaver (breadth + free tier) and SqlDBM (data warehouse specialization + DevOps integration). Surface-area reduction and modern UX are MetroGraph's wedges in a market dominated by feature-heavy or exploration-first tools.
